english_text: Can we inspect the maize field today?
yoruba_text: Ṣé a lè ṣàyẹ̀wò oko àgbàdo lónìí?

english_text: Yes, we should check the maize leaves and soil.
yoruba_text: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ó yẹ ká ṣàyẹ̀wò ewé àti ilẹ̀ àgbàdo.

english_text: The soil around the maize looks dry.
yoruba_text: Ilẹ̀ yí àgbàdo ká dà bí èyí tó gbẹ.

english_text: Let us water the maize early this morning.
yoruba_text: Ẹ jẹ́ ká bomi rin àgbàdo ní kùtùkùtù òwúrọ̀ yìí.

english_text: Some maize leaves are turning yellow.
yoruba_text: Àwọn ewé àgbàdo kan ń di ofeefee.

english_text: We should test the soil before feeding the maize.
yoruba_text: Ó yẹ ká ṣe ìdánwò ilẹ̀ kí a tó fi ajílẹ̀ sí àgbàdo.

english_text: Weeds are spreading around the maize.
yoruba_text: Èpò ń tàn káàkiri àgbàdo.

english_text: Let us remove the weeds around the maize early.
yoruba_text: Ẹ jẹ́ ká yọ èpò yí àgbàdo ká ní kùtùkùtù.

english_text: Small holes are appearing on the maize leaves.
yoruba_text: Àwọn ihò kékeré ń hàn lára ewé àgbàdo.

english_text: We should inspect beneath the maize leaves for pests.
yoruba_text: Ó yẹ ká ṣàyẹ̀wò abẹ́ ewé àgbàdo fún kòkòrò.

english_text: Dark spots are spreading on the maize.
yoruba_text: Àwọn àbàwọ́n dúdú ń tàn lára àgbàdo.

english_text: Let us separate the affected maize plants.
yoruba_text: Ẹ jẹ́ ká ya àwọn igi àgbàdo tó ní ìṣòro sọ́tọ̀.

english_text: When should we fertilise the maize?
yoruba_text: Ìgbà wo ló yẹ ká fi ajílẹ̀ sí àgbàdo?

english_text: We should follow the soil-test advice for the maize.
yoruba_text: Ó yẹ ká tẹ̀lé ìmọ̀ràn ìdánwò ilẹ̀ fún àgbàdo.

english_text: Is the maize ready for harvest?
yoruba_text: Ṣé àgbàdo ti ṣetán fún ìkórè?

english_text: Let us confirm the maturity signs on the maize.
yoruba_text: Ẹ jẹ́ ká fi àmì ìpọ́n àgbàdo múlẹ̀.

english_text: Heavy rain may reach the maize field.
yoruba_text: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí òjò líle dé oko àgbàdo.

english_text: We should clear the drainage around the maize.
yoruba_text: Ó yẹ ká ṣí ọ̀nà omi yí àgbàdo ká.

english_text: Have we recorded the growth of the maize?
yoruba_text: Ṣé a ti kọ ìdàgbàsókè àgbàdo sílẹ̀?

english_text: I will update the maize farm record today.
yoruba_text: Màá ṣe àtúnṣe àkọsílẹ̀ oko àgbàdo lónìí.

yoruba_text: Àwọn ewé ìrẹsì kan ń di ofeefee.
